lifecycle_contract.pre_reservation: Compute minimal outcome, prospective reserved bytes/pin, process=None, error bookkeeping and handler bookkeeping before consumption where possible. Preflight/source-before stays before consumption. Enter outer protected lifecycle no later than the reservation attempt; all work after successful consumption, including reserved evidence/invocation assembly, is inside it.
lifecycle_contract.reservation_boundary: A readback exception after os.replace must not be misclassified as unconsumed just because cas_author failed to return. On this exceptional path compare physical role bytes against the exact known before/reserved/spent generations and reservation ID. Never retry reservation, refund used1/rem0 or overwrite an unrelated generation. Unknown/unreadable state remains explicit failure needing ROOT reconciliation.
lifecycle_contract.finally: Owned process cleanup remains within original15s. Isolate fallible capture stages so one failure cannot skip same-key SPENT finalization and best available outcome persistence; use an outer/nested finally for those two duties. Install/restore owned TERM handling across the reserved lifecycle and ensure restoration cannot preempt finalization. Do not let failure writing optional before/author-reserved or author-before-spend evidence gate the actual SPENT attempt. Preserve original evidence bytes available in memory/in before archives; record unavailable outputs honestly.
lifecycle_contract.spent_and_output: The original author commands.t2_green remains used1/remaining0 on all consumed outcomes. Attempt exactly the authorized same-key SPENT CAS, preserving all other entries. Retain stage-specific errors and started=false/child_exit=null when no child started. Acceptance remains false for errors; no synthetic JUnit/resources/streams. Persist available actual output even if SPENT CAS fails, without overriding conflicting ledger bytes.
lifecycle_contract.mode: Read original regular ledger permission mode as part of the authorized before/CAS context; apply that actual mode to replacement files and verify it. No claim of an observed mode change; no arbitrary chmod or permission expansion.
lifecycle_contract.limit: No Python finally guarantees SIGKILL/host loss/storage failure. Such unavailable completion remains explicit RESERVED/SPENT-uncertain with used1/rem0 and needs ROOT factual reconciliation, never rerun/refund.

case_binding_contract.authority: Use actual sidecar data.nodeid and data.pid, verified against exact seven nodes and the one child PID, plus the existing resource records. Do not merely write expected PID into a record as proof.
algorithm: For every regular indexed scenario file in the six existing families, require stable full own-byte pin, confinement to this run's persistent basetemp, and no symlink/alias ownership.

Take its actual parent directory. Find initialized sqlite_connection resource records in the actual sidecars whose recorded absolute path is exactly that directory/events.db, with resource PID equal to sidecar PID equal to child PID. Those path records arise from the real frozen factory; Memory still has its genuinely created/closed original SQLite event repository. Do not fabricate SQLite events for Memory.

Require exactly one owner node/sidecar for the directory. Multiple connections inside that same sidecar are allowed and retained; cross-node ownership ambiguity, absent witnesses or contradictory PIDs fail closed. Preserve witness resource IDs and original path/data, not just a computed label.

Require expected (nodeid, actual-directory leaf, case filename) pairs below, uniquely, with no missing/extra/orphan scenario files. Derive the parent pytest directory from witnessed actual paths; never predict pytest's generated basename/suffix.

Emit each case file pin/full bytes with its actual nodeid, actual PID, sidecar pin, actual exercise directory and complete matching resource witnesses; retain the existing raw sidecar and fault scenarios. Check sidecar hashed filename/node identity already covered by original consumer; preserve all its validations.
When behavior fails or evidence is incomplete, preserve available actual files/records and report binding failures explicitly; do not invent links or accept merely the global six-family set.
case_binding_contract.interpretation: These counts describe frozen scenario outputs on complete success, not resource allocation counts. Actual resource denominators and failure/partial/transposed/neverpolled records remain independently observed by the unchanged original helper.
